#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Convert a DOCX file to PDF and email it as an attachment.

Prerequisites:
    pip install docx2pdf

    - On Linux, LibreOffice must be installed (used by docx2pdf under the hood).
    - On macOS/Windows, docx2pdf uses Microsoft Word via COM/AppleScript.

Usage:
    python convert_and_email.py

    You will be prompted for your SMTP password. Alternatively, set the
    environment variable SMTP_PASSWORD to skip the prompt.
"""

import os
import sys
import smtplib
import getpass
import subprocess
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.base import MIMEBase
from email import encoders

# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
#  CONFIGURATION — edit these values as needed
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────
DOCX_PATH = "docs/customer_report.docx"      # Input .docx file
PDF_PATH = "docs/customer_report.pdf"         # Output .pdf file

SMTP_SERVER = "smtp.example.com"              # Your SMTP server
SMTP_PORT = 587                               # 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL
USE_SSL = False                               # True → SMTP_SSL (port 465)

SENDER_EMAIL = "you@example.com"              # Your email address
RECIPIENT_EMAIL = "bob@example.com"           # Recipient
SUBJECT = "Customer Report"
BODY = "Hi Bob,\n\nPlease find the customer report attached.\n\nBest regards"
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────


def convert_docx_to_pdf(docx_path: str, pdf_path: str) -> None:
    """Convert DOCX → PDF, trying docx2pdf first, then LibreOffice CLI."""
    docx_file = Path(docx_path)
    if not docx_file.exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: '{docx_path}' not found.")

    # Attempt 1: docx2pdf (works on macOS/Windows with Word, Linux with LibreOffice)
    try:
        from docx2pdf import convert
        print(f"Converting '{docx_path}' → '{pdf_path}' using docx2pdf …")
        convert(docx_path, pdf_path)
        print("Conversion successful (docx2pdf).")
        return
    except ImportError:
        print("docx2pdf not installed, trying LibreOffice CLI …")
    except Exception as exc:
        print(f"docx2pdf failed ({exc}), trying LibreOffice CLI …")

    # Attempt 2: LibreOffice headless
    lo_bin = shutil.which("libreoffice") or shutil.which("soffice")
    if lo_bin is None:
        sys.exit(
            "Error: No conversion tool available.\n"
            "Install one of:\n"
            "  pip install docx2pdf\n"
            "  sudo apt install libreoffice   (Linux)\n"
            "  brew install --cask libreoffice (macOS)"
        )

    out_dir = str(Path(pdf_path).parent or ".")
    print(f"Converting '{docx_path}' → '{pdf_path}' using LibreOffice …")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [lo_bin, "--headless", "--convert-to", "pdf", "--outdir", out_dir, docx_path],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit(f"LibreOffice conversion failed:\n{result.stderr}")

    # LibreOffice names the output after the input; rename if necessary
    lo_output = Path(out_dir) / (docx_file.stem + ".pdf")
    expected = Path(pdf_path)
    if lo_output != expected:
        lo_output.rename(expected)

    print("Conversion successful (LibreOffice).")


def send_email(pdf_path: str, password: str) -> None:
    """Send an email with the PDF attached."""
    if not Path(pdf_path).exists():
        sys.exit(f"Error: PDF '{pdf_path}' not found. Conversion may have failed.")

    # Build the message
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = SENDER_EMAIL
    msg["To"] = RECIPIENT_EMAIL
    msg["Subject"] = SUBJECT
    msg.attach(MIMEText(BODY, "plain"))

    # Attach the PDF
    with open(pdf_path, "rb") as f:
        part = MIMEBase("application", "octet-stream")
        part.set_payload(f.read())
    encoders.encode_base64(part)
    part.add_header(
        "Content-Disposition",
        f'attachment; filename="{Path(pdf_path).name}"',
    )
    msg.attach(part)

    # Send
    print(f"Connecting to {SMTP_SERVER}:{SMTP_PORT} …")
    try:
        if USE_SSL:
            server = smtplib.SMTP_SSL(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT)
        else:
            server = smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_SERVER, SMTP_PORT)
            server.ehlo()
            server.starttls()
            server.ehlo()

        server.login(SENDER_EMAIL, password)
        server.send_message(msg)
        server.quit()
        print(f"Email sent to {RECIPIENT_EMAIL} ✓")
    except smtplib.SMTPAuthenticationError:
        sys.exit("Authentication failed. Check your email/password (or use an app password).")
    except Exception as exc:
        sys.exit(f"Failed to send email: {exc}")


def main() -> None:
    # Step 1 — Convert
    convert_docx_to_pdf(DOCX_PATH, PDF_PATH)

    # Step 2 — Email
    password = os.environ.get("SMTP_PASSWORD") or getpass.getpass("SMTP password: ")
    send_email(PDF_PATH, password)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
